summary: Bank of Montreal filed a Form 6-K on September 15, 2026, furnishing US counsel and Canadian counsel legal opinions and consents supporting the issuance of US$1,000,000,000 principal amount of Floating Rate Notes due 2028. The notes were issued under the bank's existing Form F-3 shelf registration (File No. 333-285508) covering up to US$75,000,000,000 of securities, pursuant to a 2010 indenture as supplemented. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; no price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or close date is stated. Watch for pricing spread and credit conditions.
